title: Events
description: Event objects (as carried in StepResult.Events) and the notifications/event broadcast used in shared sessions (spec section 10.3)

Event.description: Notable simulation event ({Type, Tick, Severity, Details}); the canonical definition lives in game-rl.schema.json

notification.description: JSON-RPC notifications/event broadcast sent to agents in a shared session

method.description: Notification method name (MCP protocol layer, camelCase per REQ-NAME-04)

event_params.description: Broadcast event payload (PascalCase fields per REQ-NAME-02)

Tick.description: Simulation tick when the event occurred

Visibility.description: Agent types or agent IDs that should receive this event; omitted = visible to all connected agents
